'''Ice Cream''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. 

Ice Cream can be purchased from [[Alex]] during [[Summer]] at the [[Ice Cream Stand]] for {{Price|250}}, or at the [[Oasis]] on Sundays (year-round) for {{Price|240}}. It may also randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Ice Cream may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Ice Cream is an option in the {{Bundle|Childrens||y}}.

==Recipes==
Ice Cream is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Ice Cream is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Retro Rainbow Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt039.png|24px]]

==Quests==
Ice Cream is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].

==Trivia==
*Gifting [[Jas]] Ice Cream at the [[Desert Festival]] raises [[friendship]] with her by 200 points. This can be done one time per player.
